Photo 1 lens barrel reads Nikon DX AF-S NIKKOR 18-55mm 1:3.5-5.6G VR.

risks.proof: Photo of the battery and charger with the camera.

risks.proof: Photo of the original box and paperwork.

risks.risk: Warranty status is unknown or expired.

Close-up video of sensor, mirror, and lens mount plus seller's repair history disclosure.

risks.proof: Photo of a memory card inserted in the camera.

proof_requests: Video of camera powering on, shooting, and autofocus
Photo of shutter count / info screen
Photo of original box and paperwork
response.reason: The witness identifies a Nikon D3200 with an 18-55mm lens, so the item can be priced at its worst case; the seller's D3400 and 70-300mm claims are contradicted by the photos, and functional condition is unproven so it is priced as non-working until a video proves otherwise.
